name: .224 Cal-63gr Absolute Hammer™
note: Recommended use: Small to medium big game hunting. The product page also says: "Here is an Absolute Hammer™ in the upper weight class that should scream out of the big 22 calibers. This one needs a minimum twist rate of 1-8.25″ or faster. The Absolute Hammer™s do not line up with conventional bullet data and should only be used by loaders that are used to loading wildcats and comfortable with finding their own loads without supporting data."
